# Message to Buyer (Etsy listing field)

**Use:** Paste the text below into the listing's "Message to buyer" field. Lands in the order confirmation email AND stays on the buyer's permanent Purchases page on Etsy.

**Applies to:** All Saltwash Prints digital listings (Dog on the Beach, Lonely Houses, Lady Reading, and any future print listings). One universal message — do not edit per listing.

**Last updated:** 2026-06-18

---

## The text (86 words)

```
Thanks for your Saltwash Prints order. Your download includes 5 print-ready JPGs — one for each common size: 5x7, 8x10, 11x14, 16x24, and 18x24. Each file is named for its size, so you know exactly which to send to your printer.

For the best result, print on matte or linen-finish paper. Glossy photo paper flattens the watercolor texture. Standard inkjet or laser works well.

If you reprint at a different size later, please save this message — the paper advice applies to any Saltwash print.
```

---

## Why no PDF in the download

Etsy digital listings cap at 5 download files by default. Our 5 print JPGs fill the cap. A PDF would require either (a) dropping a print size from the lineup, (b) consolidating sizes onto aspect-ratio masters (deferred to v2), or (c) requesting Etsy raise the cap. None are launch-blockers. The message-to-buyer field is Etsy's standard channel for short delivery instructions, lives in the order email + Purchases page, and is editable without re-uploading.
